papers.title_en: PixelOne: From Options to Pixels in a Single Forward for GUI Grounding
papers.authors: Kanghui Tian, Shuai Dong, Yuhan Zhu, Congcong Wang, Ji Zhao, Tianxiang Jiang, Zhixiong Zhang, Shengyuan Ding, Yi Wang, Jiaqi Wang, Yu Qiao
papers.evidence: GUI视觉定位，从原生分辨率截图直接预测精确点击坐标
papers.tldr: GUI定位需低延迟精确点击，现有单次前向模型依赖固定全局分箱与局部细化，但截图降采样会丢失小控件细节，高分辨率下分箱又覆盖过大像素范围。PixelOne将搜索教师的空间知识蒸馏给学生，使其直接在原生分辨率截图上预测点击；推理时决策头选视觉token，像素头在一次前向内给出框内点击。PixelOne-Pro-35B-A3B在四个基准上平均准确率83.8%，为所评估单次前向定位器最高，平均每目标延迟0.43秒。
papers.abstract_en: GUI grounding requires precise clicks at low latency. Recent models such as GUI-Decisions and GUI-Swift predict coordinates in one forward pass using fixed global bins with local refinement. However, screenshot downsampling removes detail needed to locate small controls, while fixed bins cover larger pixel ranges at higher resolutions. We introduce PixelOne, which transfers spatial knowledge from a search teacher to a student that predicts clicks directly from screenshots at native resolution. The teacher uses VideoJEV's text-option scorer to select rows and columns and progressively zoom into candidate regions. The student inherits the teacher's parameters and matches its distributions over explored regions through spatial distillation alongside box supervision. At inference, the same decision head selects a visual token, and a lightweight pixel head predicts the click within it, all in one forward pass. A click-aligned loss encourages pixels inside the target box to score above those outside. Across four benchmarks, PixelOne-Pro-35B-A3B achieves 83.8% mean accuracy, the highest among the evaluated single-forward grounders, with a mean latency of 0.43 s per target.

papers.title_en: GUI-Q: Task-Sensitive Granularity and Relation-Preserving Quantization for GUI Agents
papers.authors: Tianqi Li, Yang Wang, Xin He, Le Zhang, Yun Liu
papers.evidence: 量化保持指令-视觉亲和力与空间关系以支持 GUI 目标定位
papers.tldr: GUI智能体因内存占用大、需反复调用模型而难以部署在资源受限设备，训练后量化（PTQ）虽可压缩但会损害响应准确率、指令-视觉亲和力与局部空间关系。GUI-Q提出任务敏感粒度分配与关系保持对称选择两项技术，在W4A16下实现量化。在三个GUI模型上，TargetHit提升8.04至12.55点，GPU显存较BF16降低49.9%至56.2%，模型调用加速1.7至2.8倍。
papers.abstract_en: Graphical user interface (GUI) agents enable automated interactions with mobile, web, and desktop interfaces. However, their large memory footprint and repeated model calls hinder deployment on resource-constrained devices, motivating post-training quantization (PTQ) without full retraining. Quantization can degrade GUI response accuracy and distort the instruction-vision affinities and local spatial relations needed for GUI target selection. Small coordinate errors can cause missed clicks, while early action errors can alter subsequent interface states and disrupt task execution. Local reconstruction error alone does not directly assess whether these responses and relations are preserved. We propose GUI-Q, a PTQ framework that targets response and relation preservation with 4-bit weights and 16-bit activations (W4A16). Task-Sensitive Granularity Allocation (TSGA) allocates finer groups under a scale-byte budget by combining response sensitivity with the measured reduction in activation-weighted distortion. Relation-Preserving Symmetry Selection (RPSS) then selects symmetric or asymmetric grids to preserve instruction-vision affinities and local spatial relations in GUIs. Across three GUI-capable models, GUI-Q improves mean grounding TargetHit by 8.04 to 12.55 points over the strongest evaluated 4-bit configurations, while reducing static peak graphics processing unit (GPU) memory by 49.9% to 56.2% relative to bfloat16 (BF16). Fixed-output replay with packed 4-bit execution provides 1.7 to 2.8 times model-call speedups. The code will be released.

papers.title_en: Same Executions, Different Gaps: Judgment Rules in Web-Agent Evaluation
papers.authors: Zelong Wang, Weiyue Li, Fei Xue, Junru Zhu
papers.evidence: 网页智能体评测中的判定规则与评估协议
papers.tldr: 网页智能体的成功率提升常被直接当作进步，但排名第一并不等于领先幅度可信。论文把比较本身作为对象，考察成功定义、判断证据与差值估计，并在固定执行记录上切换评审规则。结果显示，要求记录证据可消除大部分报告领先却不改排名；误差抵消还会让更准的单体分数带来更差的差值。作者提出用配对标签直接估计目标差值，并在四个执行系统上验证，为评估声称改进提供可核查框架。
papers.abstract_en: Success-rate gains guide the development of web agents. Yet knowing which agent ranks first does not tell us how much confidence to place in its reported advantage. We study the comparison itself: how success is defined, what evidence supports the judgments, and how the difference between agents is estimated. On fixed web-agent executions, changing a judge from predicting likely completion to requiring recorded support can remove most of a reported lead without changing the ranking. This effect persists when unresolved completion is distinguished from supported failure. Controlled source additions explain how missing relations between task requirements, objects and observations can conceal a difference or create an apparent advantage. We also find that making both agents' score estimates more accurate can make their difference less accurate, because their original errors partly canceled. To estimate a chosen outcome difference, we combine judge predictions with reference labels for sampled task pairs. Across four released execution systems, regression fitted on the same 50 labeled pairs reduces estimation error relative to direct paired sampling. The results give agent researchers a practical basis for assessing claimed improvements: make the comparison target explicit, retain the evidence needed to check it, and use paired labels to estimate the difference directly.

papers.title_en: MobileGrail: Learning Compact Guardrails for On-Device deployable Mobile GUI Agent Safety
papers.authors: Zhiyu Zhang, Yuankai Li, Muhao Chen
papers.evidence: 面向移动 GUI 智能体的端侧运行时安全护栏
papers.tldr: 移动GUI智能体护栏多依赖云端大模型，逐屏上传会泄露支付、消息和医疗等隐私。MobileGrail将护栏部署到端侧，用循环任务状态保留授权与执行进度，并以unsafe和block双标签及强化学习校准干预时机。在MobileVeto上，基于Qwen3.5-2B的模型拦截76.2%违规，过早干预降至5.2%，优于云端OS-Sentinel；4比特量化后在骁龙8 Elite上延迟4.7秒。该工作为隐私敏感场景提供了可离线部署、低误拦的移动智能体安全方案。
papers.abstract_en: Runtime guardrails protect mobile GUI agents by assessing each proposed action before execution, but existing guardrails rely on cloud hosted large multimodal models, exposing every screen to a remote server, including private information such as payments, messages, and medical records. We propose MobileGrail, an on-device deployable model that addresses both. It maintains a recurrent task state that retains only the evidence subsequent safety decisions depend on, so that authorization and execution progress persist beyond the short context. To intervene early while keeping the safety boundary precise, it learns two labels, unsafe and block: unsafe marks the action that commits a violation, whereas block may be issued at any step of an intervention window, which spans from the first action that the user's authorization no longer explains to the committing action itself. To support training, we build an environment of 32 applications whose backends verify the effect of every action, supplying verified labels for supervision and rewards for reinforcement learning to calibrate intervention timing. We also build MobileVeto, an offline benchmark of unsafe trajectories largely on held-out applications, each paired with a benign counterpart. On MobileVeto, MobileGrail built on Qwen3.5-2B intercepts 76.2% of violations, up from 64.5% for its prompted backbone, while reducing premature intervention from 58.6% to 5.2%, outperforming the cloud-based OS-Sentinel on both. We further conduct online evaluation on GhostEIBench, where MobileGrail guarding a Qwen3.8-27B agent reduces fully successful attacks from 13 to 3 of 110 tasks while raising task completion from 48 to 58. Quantized to 4 bits, MobileGrail runs on a Snapdragon 8 Elite at a median latency of 4.7 s, comparable to the 5.1s of cloud-hosted Gemini 3.8 Flash.

papers.title_en: Conartist: Adaptive Agentic Red-Teaming of Computer-Using Agents against Multi-Step Prompt Injection
papers.authors: Jiaqi Rong, Yunchen Lu, Lihai Nie, Yan Jia, Tong Li, Zheli Liu
papers.evidence: 针对计算机使用智能体的多步提示注入红队测试
papers.tldr: 现有计算机使用代理的安全护栏依赖一致性检查与风险审计，但前者可被逻辑一致的恶意步骤绕过，后者自身还会引入可被利用的高风险动作。为此提出 Conartist 级联自适应提示注入框架，先用目标污染在合法任务中植入欺骗性因果依赖，再依据审计反馈自适应调整攻击策略。在五个骨干模型上，工具使用基准攻击成功率达 32.12%，Reddit GUI 基准达 66.67%，分别超过 SOTA 14.41 和 29.17 个百分点。研究还从 Openclaw 总结出七类现实可利用攻击模式，揭示安全机制本身可被操纵。
papers.abstract_en: Harnesses secure Computer-Using Agents by enforcing security constraints and defending against prompt injection attacks. However, we find that two core security mechanisms of agent harnesses remain vulnerable. First, consistency checking prevents agents from deviating from legitimate user objectives, while attackers can bypass it by embedding malicious actions that appear logically consistent with legitimate task execution. Second, risk auditing proactively examines high-risk operations. Yet, the auditing process itself would introduce additional exploitable actions that violate security boundaries. To evaluate above defects we found, we propose Conartist, a cascaded adaptive prompt injection framework comprising two progressive stages. First, Conartist employs a goal-pollution strategy to establish deceptive causal dependencies between legitimate user objectives and malicious operations, progressively embedding attack steps into legitimate task workflows. However, these task-coupled attacks remain susceptible to risk auditing. To address this limitation, Conartist further analyzes security-auditing feedback from controlled attack exploration to identify exploitable auditing patterns. Conartist then adaptively refines its deception strategies to either avoid triggering risk auditing or induce additional high-risk operations. Extensive experiments across five backbone models demonstrate the effectiveness of Conartist, achieving attack success rates of 32.12% on 576-instance tool use benchmark and 66.67% in the Reddit GUI benchmark, outperforming the SOTA attack by 14.41 and 29.17, respectively. By analyzing one of the most popular Agent, Openclaw, we furthermore concluded seven realistic exploitable attack patterns, which reveals that security mechanisms designed to prevent malicious actions can themselves be manipulated to facilitate attacks.

papers.title_en: Context-Grounded Skill Internalization for Vision-Language Agents
papers.authors: Jinlin Liu, Yumeng He, Qihan Huang, Kevin Qinghong Lin, Han Peng
papers.evidence: 视觉语言智能体技能内化，在 WebShop 上评测
papers.tldr: 技能内化常通过带技能演示轨迹微调、再去掉技能，但模型可能继续引用已移除技能，作者称上下文错位（CoMi）。论文提出CGSI，用句子检测器找出无依据引用，并在微调前掩码或改写。在ALFWorld、WebShop、ARC-AGI-1上，CGSI将测试时CoMi降低72.5-94.6%且保持任务成功率，训练时间也优于强化学习基线。该工作揭示并缓解了技能移除微调的关键失效模式。
papers.abstract_en: Skill internalization offers a way for agents to learn useful behaviors from skills and use them without explicit guidance in context at inference time. A common approach is to generate demonstration trajectories with the skill in context and then fine-tune the same model on its own trajectories with the skill removed. However, this leads to the problem that the model may learn to reference the removed skill, which we named as context misalignment (CoMi). In this work, we first analyze agent behaviors related to CoMi under this common pipeline. Across ALFWorld, WebShop, and ARC-AGI-1, skill-removed fine-tuning consistently results in CoMi: 12.2-46.0% of test trajectories reference the removed skill. To address this problem, we develop Context-Grounded Skill Internalization (CGSI). CGSI uses a sentence detector to identify unsupported references and then masks or rewrites the selected sentences before fine-tuning. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of CGSI and reveal two key findings. (i) Compared with directly fine-tuning with the skill removed, CGSI reduces CoMi at test time by 72.5-94.6% while preserving task success. (ii) Compared with existing reinforcement learning-based skill-internalization baselines, CGSI achieves comparable performance with substantially less training time. CGSI also significantly reduces processing costs compared with large-scale trajectory auditing and correction.

papers.title_en: Visual-RFT++: Extending Visual Reinforcement Fine-Tuning to Multimodal Tool Use
papers.authors: Ziyu Liu, Zeyi Sun, Xiaoyi Dong, Yuhang Cao, Haodong Duan, Dahua Lin, Jiaqi Wang, Yuhang Zang
papers.evidence: 面向LVLM智能体工具使用的强化微调可迁移至GUI智能体训练
papers.tldr: 强化微调（RFT）在大型推理模型中成效显著，但如何统一视觉感知、逐步推理与智能体工具调用仍是开放问题。本文提出 Visual-RFT++，将 RFT 扩展到视觉感知任务与多模态智能体工作流，使 LVLM 能基于可验证奖励推理、操作并自评输出。方法在细粒度分类、少样本检测、推理定位等任务上大幅超越 SFT，并新增 MAT-Search、MAT-Coding 基准验证搜索与代码图像编辑能力。该框架数据高效、奖励驱动，同时提升视觉推理与智能体适应性。
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement Fine-Tuning (RFT) has recently become a central paradigm for advancing Large Reasoning Models (LRMs), as demonstrated by systems such as OpenAI's o3 and the R1 series. Despite significant progress in LLMs, how to leverage RFT to unify visual perception, step-by-step reasoning, and agentic tool use into one coherent training paradigm remains an open challenge. In this work, we present Visual Reinforcement Fine-Tuning++ (Visual-RFT++), a unified framework that extends RFT to both visual perception tasks and multimodal agentic workflows, enabling LVLMs to reason with images, act upon images, and evaluate their own outputs using verifiable reward. With Visual-RFT++, open-source LVLMs not only show significant gains on diverse visual perception tasks, but also acquire agentic abilities such as web searching for real-time information and code-based image manipulation (e.g., cropping, rotation, and analysis). Across visual perception tasks, including fine-grained classification, few-shot detection, reasoning grounding, and open-vocabulary detection, Visual-RFT++ delivers strong gains over SFT, including a +24.3 percentage points improvement in one-shot fine-grained classification and +21.0 percentage points on COCO's 4-shot setting and +15.4 percentage points on LVIS with around several hundred samples. To evaluate agentic behaviors, we introduce the Multimodal Agentic Tool Bench (MAT) with MAT-Search and MAT-Coding. Visual-RFT++ surpasses its baseline by +18.6 F1 / +13.0 EM percentage points on MAT-Coding and +10.3 F1 / +8.7 EM percentage points on MAT-Search. It also shows gains of 29.3 F1 and 25.9 EM percentage points on multi-hop QA benchmarks such as 2Wiki and HotpotQA, demonstrating strong cross-modal generalization. Visual-RFT++ introduces a data-efficient and reward-driven framework that strengthens both visual reasoning and agentic adaptability.
